'''Brandon Young''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Cookeville tournament]] on 13 May 2000 with some random Operatives pile, according to Mike Wudhapitak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d773">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-cookeville-tennessee-5-13-00d773/ cookeville-tennessee-5-13-00], DeckTech (Mike "Anime Knight" Wudhapitak, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-cookeville-tennessee-5-13-00d773/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
